post_clip.description: At timestamp 04:50:26 PM (frame 6), a person wearing light-colored clothing and a helmet or cap appears on the right side of the frame, walking toward the gate. By 04:50:27 PM (frame 7), the person is near the right gate post, raising their arm in a motion consistent with striking or damaging the gate or adjacent structure — a potential act of vandalism. No prior frames show this individual; their sudden appearance and aggressive posture near property constitute suspicious activity matching the vandalism anomaly type.

The action involves repeated pushing, pulling, and leveraging against the gate structure while it remains closed, indicating deliberate tampering with property.
